settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage cloud/desktop embeddings and personal model selections in one place.

auth.requiredDesc: Sign in to view and save settings.

alert.consistencyDesc: Cloud uses the admin-selected embedding model to avoid dimension mismatches across requests.

cloud.title: Cloud Embedding (Admin Unified)
cloud.description: All cloud requests share the same embedding model.
cloud.editableHint: Admins can edit the cloud model
cloud.modelHelp: Ensures consistent vector dimensions in cloud.

desktop.title: Desktop Embedding (Local Only)
desktop.description: Only affects local desktop search, not cloud.
desktop.modelHelp: Local choice does not affect cloud dimensions.
desktop.rebuildTitle: Rebuild local memories and all vector indexes
desktop.rebuildDescription: After switching the embedding model, rebuild local memories and all local vector indexes to avoid vector-dimension mismatch errors.
desktop.rebuildCompleted: Rebuild finished: memories {memoryIndexed} succeeded / {memoryFailed} failed, assets {assetIndexed} succeeded / {assetFailed} failed.
desktop.rebuildVectorDimension: Vector dimension used for this rebuild: {dimension}.
desktop.repairTitle: Repair local registry and tool indexes
desktop.repairDescription: If local skills, MCP tools, assistants, or knowledge indexes look inconsistent, run a repair and resync pass.
desktop.unavailableDesc: Configure local embedding models in the desktop app.

network.title: Desktop Network Proxy
network.description: Control whether desktop-side upstream requests go direct, follow the system proxy, or use a custom proxy endpoint.
network.modeHelp: Applies to desktop Rust upstream model requests, provider verification, and model sync. It does not change cloud-side routing.

modeDesc.none: Bypass system and environment proxies for desktop upstream requests.
modeDesc.system: Follow the operating system or HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY environment proxy.
modeDesc.custom: Route desktop upstream requests through a specific HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS proxy.

network.urlHelp: Supports http://, https://, and socks5://. Leave empty unless Custom proxy is selected.
network.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app and applied when the Rust runtime creates outbound upstream clients.

scout.title: Desktop Scout Service
scout.description: Configure the Scout crawler endpoint used by local official crawler tools. You can point it to your own Scout deployment or the official service URL.
scout.baseUrlHelp: For example https://your-scout.example.com. When left blank, the desktop app falls back to SCOUT_SERVICE_URL from the launch environment, then to the skill default.
scout.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app, never synced to cloud. Updating it refreshes local official skill registration.

personal.title: Personal Assistant Models
personal.description: Topic auto-naming and secretary models apply only to your account.
personal.editableHint: Sign in to edit personal models
personal.topicHelp: Only your own chat models are supported.
personal.secretaryHelp: Used for secretary capabilities and assistant previews.
personal.currentUnlistedHint: This model is currently unavailable or removed.

storage.title: Desktop Object Storage
storage.description: Configure your own R2 or OSS bucket so desktop file uploads can use your storage instead of inline data fallbacks.
storage.securityHint: Credentials stay on this device only. Secret keys are encrypted before persistence.
storage.enabledHelp: When enabled, desktop image attachments prefer your configured bucket and only fall back locally if upload preparation fails.
storage.providerHelp: Start with Cloudflare R2 or Aliyun OSS. The desktop uploader reuses the same abstraction for both.
storage.bucketHelp: Bucket used for desktop file uploads.
storage.bucketHelpAliyun: Enter the plain bucket name, for example deeting. Do not paste the full domain.
storage.regionHelp: R2 usually uses auto. Aliyun OSS typically uses a concrete region like cn-hangzhou.
storage.regionHelpAliyun: Enter the Aliyun OSS region ID, for example cn-beijing. You can copy it directly from the OSS console endpoint region.
storage.pathStyleHelp: Enable this if your endpoint expects the bucket name in the URL path instead of the hostname.
storage.pathStyleHelpAliyun: For standard public Aliyun OSS bucket domains, leave this off. Enable it only if your endpoint must use a /bucket/path style.
storage.endpointHelp: Must be an HTTPS endpoint for your bucket or object storage service.
storage.endpointHelpAliyun: Enter the HTTPS regional Aliyun OSS endpoint, for example https://oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com. This is used for desktop-side request signing, must include aliyuncs.com, and should not be your custom CNAME.
storage.publicBaseUrlHelp: Required for the current desktop chat-image flow because messages still store directly readable asset URLs.
storage.publicBaseUrlHelpAliyun: Enter the final public image domain, for example https://deeting.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com or your CDN/CNAME URL. Prefer a bucket-qualified domain instead of a region-only host.
storage.pathPrefixHelp: Optional folder prefix such as desktop/uploads or chat-assets. Chat images will continue under that prefix as chat-assets/...
storage.accessKeyIdHelp: Stored locally and used only by this desktop app.
storage.secretAccessKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the current saved secret. Enter a new value only when rotating credentials.
storage.footerHint: Used only by this desktop app and never synced to cloud. Saving updates the local uploader immediately.

agent.title: Agent Execution
agent.description: Configure how the AI agent behaves when executing tool calls locally.
agent.hint: These settings affect the local AI orchestration engine.
agent.personaPromptPlaceholder: Example: Speak calmly and directly. Keep explanations practical. Do not role-play as another expert unless capability hints require domain depth.
agent.personaPromptHelp: This prompt becomes the fixed desktop reply personality. Expert routing may attach capabilities, but it will not overwrite this style or identity.
agent.chatHistoryRetentionHelp: Automatically removes full local conversation sessions by last activity time. This only affects the current desktop device and helps control local SQLite growth.
agent.maxRoundsHelp: Maximum number of agentic tool-call rounds per request. If the agent exceeds this limit it will stop and return the last response.

sandbox.title: Desktop Sandbox
sandbox.description: Check whether Code Mode will run inside BoxLite sandbox and guide the user through prepare/repair steps.
sandbox.readyHint: Sandbox is ready. Code Mode will execute in isolated mode.
sandbox.footerHint: Sandbox setup is checked on demand. Strict Code Mode execution no longer silently falls back to host Python.

window.title: Desktop Window Behavior
window.description: Control what happens when you minimize or close the desktop app.
window.minimizeHelp: Minimizing the desktop window now keeps the Island hidden and performs a standard window minimize.
window.closeActionHelp: Applies to the desktop close button and other close-window actions on this device.

closeActionDesc.showIsland: Hide the main window and keep Deeting available through the Island window.
closeActionDesc.minimize: Minimize the main window normally and keep the Island hidden.

window.saveFailed: Failed to save desktop window behavior
window.footerHint: Desktop only. This preference is stored locally on the current device.

version.title: Version Management
version.description: View the current desktop version and trigger the built-in updater manually.
version.manualHint: Run a manual check to see whether a newer desktop build is available.
version.upToDateDescription: This desktop app is already on the latest available version.
version.latestDescription: A newer desktop version is available and ready to install.
version.unavailableDescription: The updater feed is not available in this environment yet.
version.errorDescription: The updater could not be reached right now.
version.footerHint: The current version is read from the desktop runtime. Update checks reuse the existing Tauri updater flow.

browserAgent.title: Browser Agent Debug Panel
browserAgent.description: Dev-only panel to validate the desktop browser_agent tool chain.
browserAgent.bridgeUrlHelp: Desktop-only. Default is usually ws://127.0.0.1:31937/bridge (depends on your local bridge config).
browserAgent.tabIdHelp: Reuse the tabId returned by open_tab. Empty/invalid values block tab-bound actions.
browserAgent.missingTabId: Please enter a valid Tab ID first
browserAgent.missingTarget: Please provide a selector or text target
browserAgent.snapshotHelp: Returns a structured snapshot (title, visible text, links, buttons, etc.).
browserAgent.targetHelp: Prefer selector. You can also use text to target buttons/links.
browserAgent.queryHelp: Queries DOM by selector (optionally with a text filter) and returns matching elements text/html.
browserAgent.resultPlaceholder: Latest action result JSON will appear here

nav.relayDesc: Desktop proxy, Scout, and other local-only settings

actions.hint: Cloud, desktop, and personal settings are independent. Save as needed.

toast.rebuildFailed: Rebuilding local memories and vector indexes failed. Please try again.
